title: noccaea pulvinata
intro: Noccaea pulvinata, commonly known as Alpine Penny-cress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea pulvinata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and inhibit the growth of pathogens. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
